name: ssh-core-ssh-server-transfer
title: ship ssh-core ssh_server_transfer v1.0
description: Remote->remote byte transfer in 4 modes: direct (src runs scp/rsync to dst), stream (local bridges two SFTP), hybrid (direct + fallback), auto (default; direct for >100MB when reachability <1s, else stream). --use-rsync swaps scp for rsync. JSON contract: mode_used/bytes/elapsed_s/src/dst.
creator: jason
